findings: `learner.overview.text` says 午 was reused for the earthly-branch word because the pestle’s name and that word supposedly sounded alike. The dossier says the implement’s ancient name and pronunciation are unresolved and gives no independent sound comparison, so this wording overstates the proposed loan. Revise to say the picture is *proposed* to have been reused on a sound resemblance, while making clear that resemblance cannot be verified.
